name: Emma Ytterell - Article 8, § 1 - Am 84/1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 1. When the implementation of plans or when the construction, refurbishment operation or decommissioning of projects result in the occasional killing, disturbance, destruction of or damage to the nests or eggs of birds protected under Directive 2009/147/EC or other species protected under Directive 92/43/EEC, such occasional killing, disturbance, destruction or damage of protected species shall not be considered to be deliberate within the meaning of Article 5 of Directive 2009/147/EC and Article 12(1) of Directive 92/43/EEC, provided that:
